name: Berg Balance Scale
description: 14-item clinician-rated balance assessment, each scored 0–4. Administration time ~15–20 min.
shirleySays: ICC 0.97–0.99. MDC: 3.3–8.1 pts (varies). MCID: 5 pts (elderly); 12.5 pts (acute stroke). Age norms: 60–69 yr = 55; 70–79 yr = 54; 80–89 yr = 50. Potential ceiling effect in higher-functioning patients. Admin time ~15–20 min.

scoring.mcidNote: 5 pts (elderly); 12.5 pts (acute stroke); cut-off <45 = fall risk
